definitions.departure: A verified operator or officially designated point where guests meet and board for a boat trip. A meeting point is not automatically a legally designated boarding terminal.
definitions.itinerary_stop: A beach/island visited during a trip; does not imply departures originate there.
definitions.transport_port: A port used for inter-island passenger transport; not automatically an island-hopping departure point.

departure_points.limitations: Operator-specific meeting point; exact boarding location and operation must be reconfirmed for each booking.
